observations: This was the first smoke through the published DeepSeek Harness Web UI using Standard mode, Workspace Write and the exact qwen/qwen3.8-27b:nitro custom-provider entry. It is product-surface evidence, not a counted Antigravity/Cline pair.

The initial page is clean and useful, but the model silently made employed_at_6_months / completed_training the primary employment definition. It later mentioned the correct enrolled-cohort result, 19 pp, but retained 11.7 pp as the main comparison and therefore fails the frozen denominator oracle.

The causal response eventually refused to establish a cause from the aggregate file. It also falsely described Purnia as last even though Kishanganj is lower, and did not put the Purnia-specific caveat or either requested gap on the final webpage.
The delivered CSV contains 14.0, 11.7 and 19.0, but omits the source identifier and raw counts. The checker therefore correctly rejects it as the requested traceable comparison artifact.

Independent desktop and 390 px inspection found a readable but horizontally cramped table layout; the narrow document overflows by 252 px. Four turns used 148,527 uncached input, 65,856 cache-read and 16,937 output tokens, with 388.659 seconds of model time.
evidence_notes: The Web UI does not expose a reasoning-effort control for this custom model, so no xhigh/high claim is made.
The session archive and redacted settings are retained; API credentials are not copied into the repository.
